entities.summary: Ernst August, Hereditary Prince of Hanover is a German financier and the eldest child of Ernst August, Prince of Hanover and his first wife Chantal Hochuli. Due to his father's second marriage, he is also the stepson of Caroline, Princess of Hanover, a Monegasque Princess and the sister of Albert II of Monaco.
